Powers up Fairytype moves. (Hold)

Pink Bow will boost Fairy-type moves when held, giving a 20% power increase! It's a simple damage boost with no downsides.

Fairy types like Clefable or Togekiss can use this for consistent extra damage. It's not as strong as Life Orb or Choice items, but if you want power without complications, Pink Bow does the job.
